node.title: E1 profile-(2,10) cofactor-514 middle-shape logarithm router
node.statement: Among the 32 integral autocorrelation magnitude profiles in the live cofactor-514 energy window 5 through 13, exact shape-sensitive logarithm bounds exclude 15 and leave the printed 17-profile ledger. In particular energies 12 and 13 are reduced to their all-unit profiles.
node.notes: MIDDLE-SHAPE ROUTER 2026-07-29: one sparse energy-five profile lies above the field ceiling and five downward-closed L1 classes lie below the field floor. The proof uses rational atanh and exponential bounds only. Signed lags, local multiplicity, mod-257 compatibility, and support realizability remain; no E1 close or Prize movement.
